title: OutreachFollowupOutput
description: Output for a generated publisher outreach follow-up email.

followup_subject_line.description: Email subject line. Should be specific, value-forward, and avoid generic phrases.

followup_body.description: Full plain-text email body. Must reference the platform as a Google Authorized Buyer (GAB). Must not contain forbidden phrases. Day 7 must include referral request.

new_technical_value_provided.description: One-sentence summary of the new technical insight introduced in this follow-up that was not present in the previous email.

errorResponse.description: Returned when input is invalid (e.g. unknown step value).
